clock_meridiem_night: The NIGHT daypart is a midnight-crossing BAND in colloquial clock usage,
not a uniform +12 PM shift: "unha da noite" is 01:00, "dez da noite" is
22:00, twelve is midnight 00:00.  Small hours 1..5 stay AM, evening hours
6..11 are PM, twelve is midnight (band-split in resolver _clock_hms).  AM
ceiling follows the madrugada band [00:00, 06:00) transcribed for gl in
chronologia/dayparts.py; Dicionario da Real Academia Galega, s.v. "noite"

marker_alarm_at: O substantivo dun aparello que soa a unha hora fixada, e "para" despois del:

marker_alarm_joiner: The words that join two hours that share one later meridiem: "alarm for 7
marker_at_counts: Clock prepositions that also introduce a counted group: a bare hour behind one
is doubtful only right before a word of marker_counted_noun.voc.  Attested in
the parity acceptance rows; no dictionary source checked, a native reviewer is to confirm.
marker_between: Galician range "between" framing (entre A e B).
"entre": DRAG (Dicionario da Real Academia Galega), s.v. "entre" (preposicion)
-- no espazo ou tempo que media entre dous limites ("entre xuno e agosto").
marker_clock_approx: A word that makes the clock after it approximate and joins it to the day or
the part of the day before it: "pola mañá sobre as 7".  sobre: "Indica unha
localización temporal imprecisa", with the example "Chegou sobre as seis"
marker_counted_noun: Nouns that count people or things a clock never takes: a bare hour behind a
clock preposition and directly before one of them is a count ("wave at 5
people").  Each word is quoted from its Wiktionary Noun entry
(https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/<word>); the fetched pages are kept with the audit.
rapazas: Noun. "girl" (lemma rapaza, https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/rapaza, plural rapazas)
marker_date_article: The article that opens a weekday: "o luns", "quedamos o venres", and the
habitual "os luns".  "E obrigatorio se van en plural ou se quere precisar o
dia: Os luns estudio. Quedamos o venres." (EOI Lugo, "O artigo", D) Usos do
artigo determinado, p. 3).  A habitual phrase reads as the next such day.
marker_day_early: A day word followed by "cedo" names the first hours of that day: "mañá
cedo" is tomorrow morning.  RAG s.v. "cedo", 1: "Ao principio do día, nas
primeiras horas do día. [...] Volveron do mar pola mañá cedo."  Without a
day word ("chegou cedo") it is "early" and names no date.
marker_day_label: Galician day-of-month label noun: "o día 5 de decembro" names the 5th of
December.  RAG, Dicionario da Real Academia Galega, s.v. "día": "Período
de 24 horas, que é o tempo aproximado que tarda a Terra en dar unha volta
sobre o seu eixe".  "dia" is the reintegrationist spelling.
marker_dayframe: Contractions of "por" with the definite article, the usual Galician
frame for a part of the day ("pola manha", "polo serao").
Source: Dicionario da Real Academia Galega, https://academia.gal/dicionario.
marker_during: The locative "in the course of" preposition ("en xaneiro" = "in January").
Source: Dicionario da Real Academia Galega, https://academia.gal/dicionario/en.
marker_from: Galician range "from" lead -- opens a bounded or open interval and, crucially,
disambiguates the hyper-common preposition "a" (marker_to) as a genuine range
boundary: a bare "A a B" is only trusted as a range when a "from" lead is present.
"de": DRAG (Dicionario da Real Academia Galega), s.v. "de" (preposicion) --
orixe / punto de partida, correlativa de "a" ("de xuno a agosto").
"desde": DRAG, s.v. "desde" (preposicion) -- punto de orixe no tempo ou no
espazo ("desde 2010"). Normas ortograficas e morfoloxicas do idioma galego
"a partir de": DRAG -- locucion prepositiva, punto de comezo.
"do": contraccion da preposicion "de" co artigo "o" (RAG-ILG, Normas

marker_half: clock/adjectival "media/medio" plus period noun "metade" (unha das duas partes iguais) -- Real Academia Galega, Dicionario da RAG, s.v. "metade".
marker_hour_statement: The verb that states the hour, with its article: "son as 15h", "é a
unha".  "hora [...] 2 Momento determinado do día, cifra que indica este
momento no reloxo. -Que hora é? -Son as catro." (RAG, Dicionario, s.v.
marker_this: The contraction of "en" with the demonstrative: "nesta mañá" is "esta
mañá".  RAG s.v. "neste": "Contracción da preposición en co demostrativo
marker_this_not_weekday: "neste" and "nesta" read as "este" and "esta" before a part of the day or a
period ("nesta mañá", "nesta semana"), but not before a weekday.  "este
luns" picks the Monday of the current week, which can be past, while the
next occurrence is the right answer (a weekday said alone reads forward).
"neste luns" keeps the reading of the bare weekday.
marker_to: Galician range "to" boundary -- the term / upper limit of a bounded interval.
"a": DRAG (Dicionario da Real Academia Galega), s.v. "a" (preposicion) --
termo / punto de chegada, correlativa de "de" ("de xuno a agosto").
"ata": DRAG, s.v. "ata" (preposicion) -- indica o limite temporal ou espacial
("de xuno ata agosto"). Normas ortograficas e morfoloxicas (RAG/ILG).
"deica": DRAG, s.v. "deica" (preposicion) -- ata un limite no tempo ou espazo.
